title: There is / there are: review
instructionEs: Preguntas mezcladas de toda la unidad.

items.prompt: There are ___ books on the desk.
items.explanationEs: En afirmativas con plural se usa some.

items.statement: There is a lot of informations.
items.explanationEs: Information es incontable y no tiene plural: a lot of information.

answers: There is a bank near here.
items.explanationEs: «Hay» = there is. No se usa have.

items.text: ___ there a bus to the airport?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta: is va antes de there.

items.source: There are some tomatoes in the fridge.
answers: There aren't any tomatoes in the fridge.
There are no tomatoes in the fridge.
items.explanationEs: Negativa: aren't + any, o are no.

items.sentence: In my town have a big park.
items.explanationEs: «Hay» se dice there is: In my town there is a big park.
